name: Donjimeno (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag with a red diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly and a white canton bearing the crowned municipal arms of Donjimeno (a church tower on red above waves).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 6 October 1995 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 216 of 10 November 1995); the flag is described as square, yellow, with a red bend and a white canton at the upper hoist bearing the municipal arms on both faces.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
